title: Just Juice Apple & Pear On Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Just Juice's Apple & Pear on Ice e-liquid is a fruity concoction that will invigorate your taste buds. The combination of tangy apple and succulent pear creates a delightful balance of sweet and tart flavours, while the icy menthol finish adds a refreshing chill to the mix. With every inhale, you'll experience the crispness of fresh apples and the juiciness of ripe pears, followed by a cool exhale that leaves a satisfyingly chilly sensation on your palate. Shortfill bottles from Just Juice E-liquids provide the ideal way to personalize your nicotine levels to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as an economical and convenient option. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils, ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production. Make your vaping more efficient and enjoyable by stocking up on your preferred e-liquids in shortfills. With blends tailor-made to light up your tastebuds, UK E-liquid legends Just Juice create the tangiest, tastiest, fruitiest flavours around. The flavours are long-lasting, less allergenic and easier on the throat than many alternative e-liquids and come in 50/50, Nicotine Salt and shortfills.
